name: Inter Stable Token
collateral: Overcollateralized crypto vaults on Agoric accepting IBC-bridged ATOM and stATOM, plus a Parity Stability Module (PSM) that mints IST 1:1 against approved stablecoins (USDC, USDT, DAI) bridged from Ethereum via IBC
pegMechanism: Two complementary mechanisms on Agoric: (1) Inter Protocol vaults mint IST against IBC-deposited crypto collateral with a stability fee, liquidation ratio, and Dutch-auction liquidations; (2) the Parity Stability Module swaps approved IBC stablecoins for IST at 1:1, anchoring the peg. IST is also the Agoric platform's native fee token.

reserves.name: Parity Stability Module stablecoin reserves (IBC USDC/USDT/DAI)

notices.title: DefiLlama vs CoinGecko supply mismatch
notices.message: DefiLlama (llamaId 135) tracks only the Osmosis IBC slice of IST (~$150k peggedUSD) and does not include native Agoric supply, Archway, or Secret Network deployments. CoinGecko reports the full ~$1.4M circulating supply across all chains. Pharos uses the DefiLlama series as the primary feed; the headline figure here will reflect the Osmosis slice only until upstream coverage broadens.
